records.population_selection: Unrelated western-European adults selected for GWAS, preferring the oldest family members. Exclusions: diabetes by self-report or FPG >=7.0 mmol/L; anemia at the reported sex-specific thresholds; missing HbA1c, erythrocytes or FPG. Source context: CTX_JANSEN_SELECTED.
records.measurement_assumptions: Native source units and selected scenario. Jansen HbA1c converted with explicit NGSP affine relation; no plasma/serum or assay harmonization claim. Qualified equal weighting and intercept convention where relevant.
records.uncertainty_treatment: Point only; published uncertainty is not individual SD or a fitting tolerance. Jansen printed interval confidence level and SE unresolved. No pooling or precision weighting.
records.cross_source_overlap: Same-family Jansen effects are jointly accounted once. Bao and MIND are separate named families; cross-source overlap unconfirmed; no precision benefit assumed. Converted Jansen units are one statistic.
records.reason: Joint coefficients require assumed residual covariance and nuisance independence; numerical equality in the constructed source law is algebraic fitting, not validation.
